findings.reader: A well-executed dated news article: it answers the September 10 event first, makes provider visibility and its limits concrete through one honest, reconnected analogy, and teaches a genuinely reusable four-level evidence ladder. Attribution discipline is consistent, uncertainty survives every explanation, and the closing question equips readers for future headlines. No failure family is present; all outcomes pass.
findings.facts: All thirteen claims verify against the supplied Anthropic, AP and Axios excerpts using exactly their designated sources, with attribution and evidence limits preserved throughout. Dates and periods are traceable, new responses are distinguished from underlying activity, and the article never upgrades provider observations into proven intent or outcome. Factual integrity is clean with no defects.
